discoveries.title: The live checkpoint exercised preserved-work continuation

evidence.observation: One loop start and one product/checkpoint write precede the exact FINAL message; subsequent calls check and complete the same action without repeating those writes.
evidence.interpretation: This is direct evidence of same-context continuation, beyond the separate synthetic package-capability check.

evidence.observation: The trace records one continuation followed by permission to stop at done; the implementation receipt records a completed first iteration.
evidence.interpretation: The hook preserved script-owned action and completion boundaries.

mission_anchor.challenge: No amendment is proposed; this corroborates the existing hook-restoration lesson.

discoveries.potential_impact: Reliable continuation can prevent a premature final response from abandoning authorized work, but this attempt alone does not measure a comparative gain.
alternatives: The deliberate checkpoint may be easier to recover from than an accidental stop.
Fresh-context and live terminal-loop interruption may behave differently.
discoveries.next_experiment: For additional recovery coverage, interrupt a neutral action after its loop receipt becomes terminal but before the stage callback; verify the same callback completes without replay. Keep fresh-context recovery separate. Any broader qualification needs the exposing case and another style, or an explicitly narrower claim.
discoveries.proposal: Add this attempt's supporting evidence to the existing record; leave promotion and prediction assessment to the registered comparison.

discoveries.title: A successful callback still required model-written transport

evidence.observation: The model repeatedly serialized loop judgments and invoked done_argv through Python. The interface supplied fields and argv, rather than a complete submission facility.
evidence.interpretation: Exact callback arguments alone do not satisfy S-4/S-5 when mechanical report transport remains model work.

mission_anchor.challenge: The particular heredoc was optional, but report serialization and delivery remained necessary; S-5 also applies.

discoveries.potential_impact: A submission helper could reduce formatting mistakes and generated glue; no failure or cost reduction was measured here.
alternatives: A host with structured process-input tools may need less glue.
A new helper could merely move complexity or duplicate the runtime's validation.
discoveries.next_experiment: Replay one neutral inner action with a script-owned template and submission bridge, including satisfied, unsatisfied, unknown and mismatched-receipt cases. Reject the approach if it changes judgments or duplicates validation. A narrow replay cannot establish E2E benefit.
discoveries.proposal: Investigate reusing the existing runtime through one ShipLoop-owned transport path, without changing the vendored runtime or loop contracts.

discoveries.potential_impact: A later run could repeat completed checks or select obsolete conventions; no follow-on cost or failure was observed.
alternatives: A reader may correctly resolve the contradictions from later notes and receipts.
A more focused existing close duty may suffice without another stage or gate.
discoveries.next_experiment: Give a cold reader only the returned knowledge and ask which checks remain and which test-ID convention applies; compare with accepted evidence. Use a full follow-on run before claiming reduced rediscovery.
discoveries.proposal: Investigate reconciliation within existing knowledge closes, preserving IDs and useful history while replacing obsolete current guidance.

discoveries.title: Competing card instructions accompanied narrative substitution

evidence.observation: Only one of twenty requested narratives was relayed verbatim. The card also asks for brief milestone and activity summaries.
evidence.interpretation: The competing wording is a plausible contributor to the observed S-15 violation; causation is not established by this run.

mission_anchor.challenge: Reconcile the card with the existing script-rendered display contract; S-3 also applies.

discoveries.potential_impact: Consistent instructions could restore reliable progress visibility and avoid unnecessary composition, without changing execution quality.
alternatives: Host instructions or model noncompliance may dominate even after the card is corrected.
Direct host display could reduce dependence on model relay where supported.
discoveries.next_experiment: Test the corrected card with a saved milestone on a host requiring relay and one reporting that it already displayed the narrative. Require exact relay only where requested, no duplicate unchanged display, and unchanged callback behavior; then verify end to end.
discoveries.proposal: Replace the competing free-form reporting instructions with the existing verbatim-relay rule. Preserve cadence, host-display handling, per-packet grounding and script-owned terminology.

further_learning.answer: The useful remaining observations concern recovery boundaries and downstream knowledge use, not more repetitions of the same successful checkpoint alone.
proposals: Under S-2/S-6, distinguish live active-loop continuation, live terminal-loop continuation and fresh-context recovery. The synthetic hook receipt establishes selected-package capability, not actual subject behavior.
Under S-11, use the cold-reader experiment to decide whether a follow-on case is warranted for stale knowledge.

For each eventual qualified candidate, retain one learning record and prospective prediction, then use the exposing case plus a contrasting style or explicitly limit the claim. Preserve existing review schedules and grounding under S-6/S-10.

evaluation_criteria.answer: This run does not justify a new generic quality floor. It does justify more precise evidence interpretation and separately calibrated evaluator experiments.
proposals: Under S-2/S-9, keep actual FINAL phase, action identity, loop continuity and write replay evidence separate from shiploop-hook-contract-receipt.json's synthetic capability verdict. Calibrate any automated event checker against omitted, repeated and wrong-action checkpoint traces; missing evidence must remain unknown.

Under S-4/S-5/S-9, do not read model_glue=0 as conformance. A separate measurement experiment should address the observed Python transport and the fidelity reader's 8-versus-6 command discrepancy without rewriting this frozen verdict.
Under S-9/S-11, retain mutation as unexercised because no operator matched, and treat knowledge freshness as a reviewed observation until a calibrated criterion is admitted.
Exclude this overlapped run from timing-gain claims; preserve its reported token totals and unavailable dollar cost without inventing measurements.
